name: Celia
self_text: I am a Spanish woman in my late 30s who spends a lot of my free time reading history. When I turn to my console, these days it's all Skyforge Arena for me. I first discovered the game a while back and have since found myself drawn to the competitive side of things, so I'm mostly into ranked matches. A typical session involves me being on voice chat while I play, and I usually end up in a support role. Most weeks I can do Saturday afternoon for gaming.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available Saturday afternoon and we have to overlap on voice chat. It would be nice if you are into Skyforge Arena, but no big deal.
I need you to be available Saturday afternoon. I'd strongly prefer that we overlap on voice chat, though it's not a requirement. A small bonus if you are into Skyforge Arena.
